Data coverage & calculation

Data comes from GeckoTerminal, across up to 3 of the most liquid pools returned per selected listing. Each request returns at most 300 recent swaps per pool from the past 24 hours. Smaller pools, unindexed tokens, other exchanges, and older swaps may be missing. Select all combines the shown search matches only; it does not establish that they are official versions of the same token.

The selected time window filters the returned sample; it does not fetch a complete history. Combined flow adds USD values across your selected chains and contracts. Swaps between two selected contracts on the same chain are excluded from combined flow. Individual views still show those swaps. Net flow is observed buy USD volume minus observed sell USD volume, not total capital inflow or a price forecast. Multi-pool routes can contain multiple swap legs.

Size bands: S < $100; M $100–<$1,000; L $1,000–<$10,000; XL ≥ $10,000. Duplicate events are counted once per chain. Pool requests are shared when selected contracts use the same pool. Automatic refresh runs every 60 seconds while this page is visible; requests are paced to reduce rate limits.
